title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, example playbooks, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR adds a set of RAG agent quickstarts focused on tool-calling workflows, example playbooks for common integrations (search, calendar, and ticketing), and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide engineers with end-to-end, runnable examples that show how to wire Redwood agents to external tools safely and with structured output. Includes a small test harness and CI examples for the redwood-examples repo. Changes include new example code, docs site content, and a couple of helpers in the agent SDK to simplify tool registration. Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart examples and playbooks - [x] Update docs site with walkthroughs and architecture diagrams - [x] Add CI job for running example smoke tests - [x] Address initial lint failures and update docs links Related: Linear ENG-2987 (RAG quickstart set), ENG-3042 (agent tool-calling ergonomics).
